messages.author: 68d98962ec500b88
messages.subject: full covariance matrix in lavaan
parts:
when I try to have full covariance matrix in lavaan  using command 
mod2.ests <- sem(mod2, data = light, fixed.x=FALSE, meanstructure = TRUE)
summary(mod2.ests)
print(cov(mod2.ests))
it gave me error (Error in cov(mod2.ests) : supply both 'x' and 'y' or a matrix-like 'x')

what is that mean and how to solve it.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: full covariance matrix in lavaan
parts:
If you are looking for the (residual) covariance matrix among observed or latent variables, use inspect(mod2.ests, "coef")

If you are looking for the the covariance matrix for the entire vector of estimated parameters (i.e., the diagonal of which is used to calculate the SEs), then use vcov(mod2.ests), not cov(mod2.ests)

Terry
